subject.title: fix: use arrow function for process.exit consistently

question: Should this behavior-neutral cleanup receive a proof override, or must the contributor execute and capture both respawn paths before merge?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness defect, but repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof for external non-docs PRs and the submitted evidence only inspects source text.

options.title: Require respawn proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal output demonstrates compile-cache and general CLI respawning with exit-code propagation.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the behavior-neutral substitution without runtime proof and apply the proof override.

recommendation.title: Require respawn proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal output demonstrates compile-cache and general CLI respawning with exit-code propagation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the merged work that introduced and validated the supervised respawn lifecycle touched here.
